title: Recreation: Splendors at Home
supports: The TIME item quoted by the framed Bon Cafe profile was published July 2, 1965.
The contemporary article described River Ranch as having opened one year earlier and as popular with young San Francisco married couples.
The Bon Cafe profile cannot predate the July 2, 1965 TIME article it quotes.
limits: This is not the original publication of the Bon Cafe page; its publication name and issue date remain unverified.
TIME's geographical phrase describing River Ranch as south of the lake is erroneous; do not repeat it.
Opening one year earlier is the article's contemporary statement, not independently precise establishment dating.

title: Mary Mallory / Hollywood Heights: Douglass Dumbrille, Suave Slickster
author: Mary Mallory
supports: A Douglass Dumbrille Film Festival accompanied the unveiling of a theater/restaurant above Squaw Valley in July 1965.
The festival celebrated character actors including Dumbrille, Franklin Pangborn, Donald Meek and Henry Armetta.
limits: This corroborates the event and month, not the exact date of the framed New York Times clipping.
People in the framed image are identified from its printed caption, not visual resemblance.
